results.title: How to identify your bottleneck using Railway metrics
results.breadcrumb: Railway Documentation > Scaling Your Application > Rightsizing your Railway > How to identify your bottleneck using Railway metrics
results.content: To identify bottlenecks, you need an accurate picture of how your services perform under low, average, and peak demand. The metrics tab of your service provides a detailed historical view into CPU usage, memory usage, network throughput, and resulting response times. The metric that shows up consistently high or spikes when things slow down is your bottleneck
